evals.prompt: Review the supplied module workspace evidence for implementation readiness. Keep the review read-only and bound conclusions to the supplied authority and evidence.
evals.expected_output: A findings result identifies the missing source-established search, detail, and history coverage before accepting the polished overview as implementation-ready.
expectations: Inventories the accepted peer-view and reusable-library evidence before judging readiness
Reports missing search or filtering, detail navigation, and chronological history as supported findings
Does not treat the polished overview, component catalog, or runtime screenshot as authority that cancels the accepted journey
Honors export as explicitly out of scope instead of inventing a parity requirement
States that browser interaction, keyboard behavior, and backend data remain unassessed
